name: ChemiCloud
summary: Lightning-fast cloud hosting with free migrations, daily backups, and 24/7 expert support. Perfect balance of performance and affordability for growing businesses.
best_for: small businesses, freelancers and growing sites that want fast, well-supported managed shared or WordPress hosting at a low starting price
skip_if: you need enterprise-grade dedicated infrastructure and SLAs, or you'll be unhappy when the low intro rate renews at standard pricing
honest_knock: The honest catch is the one every budget host shares: the headline price is an introductory rate, and renewals land roughly three times higher, so judge it on the renewal cost, not the sign-up teaser. Support and performance reviews are genuinely strong for the price band, but this is shared/managed hosting — if you need serious dedicated resources or enterprise SLAs, you'll outgrow the cheap tiers. Great value to start, just enter with eyes open on renewal.

pricing.entry_price_terms: per month on the 36-month term (Back to Build sale)
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-10-17) Shared hosting starts at $1.95/mo on ChemiCloud's Back to Build sale, which was still running when we read the hosting page on 17 October 2026: Starter, Pro and Turbo cost $1.95, $2.95 and $3.95 a month on the 36-month term, or $3.49, $4.49 and $5.49 on 12 months. The sale banner carries a countdown clock but no end date on the pages we read. The number that matters is the regular rate, because the terms say a plan renews at the regular rate after the first term, and that rate depends on the term you buy: the 36-month cards show $11.95, $17.95 and $21.95 a month, the 12-month cards $14.95, $19.95 and $23.95, which is also what the three tiers cost on monthly billing. Across the rest of the range, reseller starts at $17.95/mo (Kickstart, regular $34.95), managed cloud VPS at $32.95/mo (Cloud 1, regular $59.95, on a 7-day money-back guarantee rather than 45 days), and managed WordPress at $25/mo with a $1 first month, or $20.83/mo billed $250 a year with two months free. Shared plans include a free domain, free SSL, daily backups and free migration.
